title: Amel?
overview: Amel? is a feature-length documentary essay by Jonas Bomba and Joschua Zehner. Following a personal pursuit from Germany to Paris, the film weaves intimate portraits with poetic observations, blurring the line between memoir and travelogue. Premiered at Festival Internacional de Cine de Autor Guadalajara 2022, later screened at Asti International Film Festival 2023.
